ordinance: San Francisco Planning Code, city zoning data as of November 9, 2026
map_title: Zoning Map - Zoning Districts, San Francisco Planning Department, DataSF copy of November 9, 2026
structure: 77 district codes in five groups: residential, mixed use, commercial, industrial and public.
hierarchy: Height limits and special use districts are separate layers of the city's zoning map and are not shown here.
method: The city's district polygons are cut by today's assessor blocks. Parks and federal land are shown without a district, as in the other years.
